facts.text: California Baptist University runs International Service Projects, training student teams throughout spring for two- to eight-week summer cross-cultural service opportunities worldwide.

sources.title: Global Service - California Baptist University
sources.quote: ISP is a program that brings together teams of CBU students to do life, learn, and serve globally. These teams, mentored and trained throughout the spring semester, join with field partners worldwide for two to eight-week cross-cultural service opportunities
